name: Angels Crossing
source:
It is a truth universally acknowledged, that an intern bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, will be overworked and underpaid.

Gina knows it best, having been recently terminated for a mistake they made.

So, running off nothing but stale coffee and last week's dinner, Gina decides to give them a piece of their mind.

And it may, or may not be a sane mind.

[From [url=https://hatsvin.itch.io/angels-crossing]itch.io[/url]]
